name: 265/35 R20 Inferno hot slick (Apex V8)
_note: A slick for the Apex built to put the Inferno down: far stickier than the stock semi-slick (1.8 times the load in drive and braking grip, 1.6 times in cornering; the stock tyre: 1.2 and 1.04). Same size as the stock tyre, on the Apex's 20" rims. With the Inferno: 0–100 km/h in 2.7 s instead of 4.0, the quarter mile in 8.9 s at 297 km/h instead of 10.5, and 1.68 g round the skidpad instead of 1.07. Grips the gravel and grass no better than the stock tyre.
